Hi Sana / Marcus,

Thanks again for the time last week — as we prep for the renewal QBR + roadmap demo I want to propose a slightly different cadence to ensure the execs and engineering tracks both get what they need. Instead of a single monolithic demo, we think in "slabs":

- Slab A (15–20m): Customer highlights, success metrics, business outcomes
- Slab B (35–40m): Product deep-dive (model perf, latency profiles, quantization/ops improvements)
- Slab C (20–25m): Roadmap & rollout plan + procurement/checklist time

Total ~90 minutes with a 10-minute buffer between slabs for breakouts.

Quick asks:
- Do your execs need the full session recorded and distributed? If so, which stakeholders must be able to view immediately (EU execs prefer recordings for asynchronous review).
- Are there hard blackout windows 11/24–11/27 for your team? We are proposing Wed 11/25 10:00–11:30 CET or Thu 11/26 14:00–15:30 CET as initial options.
- Internal ops: Marissa, can you confirm who will own the recording/upload and the follow-up MOP?

Attached: QBR_demo_agenda.pdf (draft), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (placeholder).

Thanks — happy to adjust.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0184
